set.body:
Implement one linear-position resampling path onto a caller-provided regular grid. Name timestamp origin, endpoint inclusion, interpolation maximum gap, missingness propagation, per-eye policy and antialiasing limitations; no hidden extrapolation or downsampling claims. Preserve source provenance and report generated/dropped support. Acceptance: analytic ramp and missing-interval cases, boundary/clock/unit rejection, batch and supported-platform checks. Queue additional interpolation/antialiasing modes only after this bounded slice.

Keep each implementation review below roughly half a day; if the scope exceeds that, split before implementation and retain the parent acceptance. Follow repository law/mutation and landing gates. This is required gap work owned by the comparison epic; completion needs evidence, not title closure.
set.title: PM1.6 Implement an explicit regular-grid resampling contract
